body: T14 ANIMATION SPEC FOR GA - Correct answer celebration. PROBLEM: Correct answer feedback (green border, checkmark) appears instantly. No moment of reward. ADHD reward system needs an instant dopamine signal within 500ms of submit. BEHAVIOR: On correct answer, .question-card gains .correct-flash class. CSS: @keyframes correctFlash { 0%,100%{box-shadow:none} 15%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(63,185,80,0.9)} 85%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(63,185,80,0.6)} }. Duration: 800ms, fill-mode: forwards. Trigger: add class immediately after grading, before showing feedback text. START: default card state, no shadow. TRIGGER: correct answer evaluated. KEYFRAMES: 0% no shadow, 15% full green ring 3px, 85% 0.6 opacity ring, 100% ring remains at 0.4 opacity. END STATE: card has permanent subtle green ring rgba(63,185,80,0.4) indicating correct. REDUCED MOTION: skip keyframes, set end state directly (permanent green ring only). Accept: animation starts within 1 frame of grade. Lasts exactly 800ms. End state is permanent subtle ring. Reduced motion shows ring immediately without animation.
